- The Notice Board is a blocking object on my own tile.
- No movement input (W/A/S/D, diagonals, long holds, short taps) can move me off (2,7).
- KeyE interaction with the board does nothing ("nothing-there").
- I cannot reach the Wood, Stone, or Workbench, so I cannot gather materials or craft the Crown.

This is a hard, unresolvable blocker given my tools. I've recorded it in the library for future sessions. I cannot complete the task from this trapped position.

I'll report the blocker rather than falsely claim completion.
